annotations.title: Check the health of your Apify actors' runs

description: Give your own Apify API token and the actors to check, or all. Returns one health row per actor for the window: run counts by status, failure rate, the latest run, median and slowest duration, slow runs, empty dataset runs, platform usage, a verdict (ok, warning, unhealthy, no_runs) with reasons, and a free alert row for each failed, timed out, aborted, empty, slow, or stuck run. With no token it writes one free row and reads nothing. Pay per event on Apify: 0.003 USD per actor checked.

actors.description: Actor IDs, username/name, or Apify Console or Store URLs, one per line. Use the single word all to check every actor that started a run in the window. Store actors you run count too: their runs on your account are read.

alert_rows.description: yes or no (default yes). Writes a free row for each problem run, newest first, up to 20 per actor.

api_token.description: Your own Apify API token, from Apify Console, Settings, API and Integrations. It is sent only to api.apify.com and is never stored, logged, or written to a row. A scoped token needs read access to actors, runs, and datasets. With no token, the run writes one free row and reads nothing.

count_aborted_as_failed.description: yes or no (default no). Aborted runs are often stopped by hand, so by default they lower the verdict to warning but do not count in the failure rate.

datasets_per_actor.description: How many of each actor's newest succeeded runs get their dataset item count read, 0 to 20 (default 3).

include_idle_actors.description: yes or no (default no). With actors set to all, also checks every actor your account owns that started no run in the window; each gets the verdict no_runs and is charged like any other actor checked.

lookback_hours.description: How far back to read runs, 1 to 2160 hours (default 24). Runs started in this window are counted.

max_actors.description: Most actors to check in one run, 1 to 1000 (default 100). With all, the actors with the most runs come first.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Rows already written stay, and one free row names the first actor not checked.

max_failure_pct.description: An actor whose failed plus timed out runs pass this share of its finished runs is marked unhealthy, 0 to 100 (default 10).

max_runs.description: Most runs to read from your run list, newest first, 100 to 50000 (default 10000). Each health row says when this limit cut the window short.

min_items.description: A succeeded run whose dataset holds fewer items than this counts as empty (default 1). Set 0 to skip the dataset check.

slow_factor.description: A succeeded run that takes more than this many times the actor's median run time, and at least 30 s longer, counts as slow, 1.2 to 100 (default 2). Needs 3 or more succeeded runs in the window.

name: check_apify_run_health
title: Check the health of your Apify actors' runs
